glasses-finder.shortDescription: Find glasses by fit, prescription, frame measurements, style, and budget.
glasses-finder.longDescription: Glasses Finder helps shoppers compare physical eyeglass frames by current frame measurements such as 52-18-140, face shape, frame width, prescription type, progressive-lens support, material, style, blue-light preference, and budget. It separates known facts from fit inferences and missing product data, then reminds users to verify prescription, measurements, lens options, and final price with the merchant.
starterPrompts: I wear 53-18-145. Find progressive glasses under $200.
Find lightweight frames for a narrow square face.
glasses-finder.affiliateDisclosure: Glasses Finder may earn a commission when users buy through partner links. Recommendations rank user fit first.
glasses-finder.safetyPolicy: Provide shopping guidance, not eye-care diagnosis. Users must confirm their prescription, pupillary distance, measurements, lens options, and final price with the merchant or an eye-care professional.
